description: This PHP class 'ArrayModel' implements the 'Normalizable' interface and provides a constructor to initialize with an array of data, and a method to return that data as an array. It likely serves as a data container within the OrangeHRM API v2 model namespace.

classes.name: ArrayModel
classes.description: A simple model class that encapsulates an array of data and allows it to be retrieved, implementing the Normalizable interface.
